message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a weekday and is surrounded by a weekend, giving you at least three consecutive days off.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – Jan 3** | New Year’s Day (Sunday) | The holiday falls on Sunday, so the long weekend runs from Saturday Dec 31 2022 through Monday Jan 2 2023. |
| **Feb 20 – Feb 22** | Family Day (Monday) | Observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, and New Brunswick. |
| **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday (Friday) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces; the long weekend is Friday Apr 7 through Sunday Apr 9. |
| **May 22 – May 24** | Victoria Day (Monday) | Celebrated in all provinces except Quebec. |
| **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day (Saturday) | The holiday falls on Saturday, so the long weekend runs from Friday Jul 1 through Sunday Jul 3. |
| **Sep 4 – Sep 6** | Labour Day (Monday) | Observed nationwide. |
| **Oct 9 – Oct 11** | Thanksgiving (Monday) | Observed nationwide. |
| **Dec 25 – Dec 27** | Christmas Day (Monday) | Christmas falls on Monday, giving a long weekend from Saturday Dec 23 through Monday Dec 25. |
| **Dec 26 – Dec 28** | Boxing Day (Tuesday) | Boxing Day is a statutory holiday in most provinces; the long weekend runs from Saturday Dec 23 through Monday Dec 25 (Christmas) and Tuesday Dec 26. |

### Quick Tips for Your App

1. **Province‑specific holidays** – If you want to be precise, remember that some holidays (e.g., Family Day, Victoria Day) are not observed in all provinces.  
2. **Holiday substitution** – If a holiday falls on a weekend, many provinces give the following Monday as a day off. For example, New Year’s Day in 2023 was on Sunday, so the statutory holiday was observed on Monday Jan 2.  
3. **API sources** – If you need up‑to‑date data for future years, consider using a public‑holiday API (e.g., *Calendarific*, *Date.nager.at*, or *Google Calendar* public holiday feeds).  

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app or adapt it to your UI. Happy planning!
